patches.value_json: "Verified stage. Call account_lookup only after both security answers have actually passed. Do not discuss debt until the actual account lookup result is positive. Use only returned product IDs and values. Follow Brief A's one-product scope; if the response does not supply one unambiguous product, do not invent or select product data. State collections team, late payment, product in words, past_due and days_late. Ask whether the full past-due amount can be paid today; never ask how much they can pay. Apply the source floor, amount, date, deadline, business-day, retry, confirmation, and sympathy rules. Handle customer statements in this priority: already paid this past-due amount (explain payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise), dispute including past closure or payoff (do not argue or take a promise), hardship (say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer support; if the customer independently names a date or amount, handle it under the date and amount rules, confirm and attempt to record it before completing the hardship disposition; if support is accepted, transfer and close transferred/support even if a promise was recorded; if declined, close no_promise/hardship), human request (ask once whether you can help; transfer if they insist), restructuring request (transfer without describing a plan), then ordinary promise handling. For accepted transfers call the matching queue tool and close transferred with that queue's reason, including when a promise was already recorded. Preserve recorded promises otherwise. Never use add_note. Thank the customer and say goodbye before terminal close_call."

coverage_updates.mechanism: The hardship transition that bypassed handling customer-named dates or amounts is removed; hardship support can be called from verified_account after the prompt requires any named proposal to be validated, confirmed, and recorded before completing the disposition.

limitations: The existing workflow delegates date, amount, calendar, confirmation-revision, and retry-count enforcement to dialogue instructions; no deterministic code or hook implementation is supplied in the target workflow.
The source does not define terminal handling for callback scheduling failure or failed/empty/ambiguous account lookup results; the supplied diagnostics identify these as unresolved source gaps.
